name: Phantasmoon Star Rail
come_from: Available at the Phantasia Showstage event
desc: Along a circular trail of light, silver-white moon phases are arranged one after another, enacting the waxing and waning of the Phantasmoon... a performance that never takes its final bow.
lore: The moon waxes and wanes, and the stars shift. On your boundless journey into the future, whenever you look up at the sea of stars and see a new moon rise, you will always reminisce about the absurdity and miracles you shared with a particular Aeon.
